nvitk.cli._sge.cluster_paths(*, data_root: pathlib.Path, output_root: pathlib.Path, container: pathlib.Path | None = None, models: pathlib.Path | None = None, nvitk_src: pathlib.Path | None = None) → nvitk.cluster.sge.ClusterPaths¶

Build a ClusterPaths for a CLI job, filling container/models/source paths from nvitk.cli.config defaults where not overridden.

nvitk.cli._sge.default_resources(*, gpu: bool = False) → nvitk.cluster.sge.SgeResources¶

Default SgeResources for a CLI job, requesting a GPU slot when gpu is True (else CPU-only).

Build python command run inside Singularity (container paths).

nvitk.cli._sge.submit_tool_job(*, job_name: str, python_cmd: str, data_root: pathlib.Path, output_root: pathlib.Path, gpu: bool = False, emit: object | None = None) → str | None¶

Submit (or, if emit is given, append to that script file handle instead of submitting) one SGE stage running python_cmd under Singularity, using default resources/binds for gpu.

nvitk.cli._sge.emit_submit_script(*, script_path: pathlib.Path, stages: list[tuple[str, str]], data_root: pathlib.Path, output_root: pathlib.Path, gpu: bool = False) → pathlib.Path¶

Write a qsub shell script at script_path containing one job stage per (job_name, python_cmd) in stages, sharing the header and cluster paths.
